title: Lick Observatory Charge-Coupled-Device Data Acquisition System
lineage: NASA NTRS record 19870065201 preserves the original paper abstract. The sixth author and DOI are present in coauthor S. L. Allen's bibliography.

passages.note: Robinson and colleagues describe a programmable CCD controller, with electronics at the dewar and a serial link to a UNIX computer for acquisition and online analysis. They report operation with several CCD types and describe astronomical instruments using the system.
